players.product: memory test handlers & HBM cube probers

quarterly_data.signal: Market-position table in the Q1 2026 IR book (company figures, approximate): memory test handlers - market about KRW 300 billion, Techwing revenue about KRW 200 billion, 70% share (No. 1), customers SK Hynix and Micron, competitor SEMES; SoC test handlers - market about KRW 900 billion, Techwing revenue about KRW 50 billion, 5% share, customers Infineon and Amkor, competitors Cohu and Hontec; HBM Cube Prober - a new market in which Techwing holds a 100% share with no competitor, customers SK Hynix, Micron and Samsung Electronics. The company describes the Cube Prober as the only solution for full inspection of individual HBM stacks, and says a next-generation memory handler is in preparation.
quarterly_data.figure: memory handler market about KRW 300 billion, 70% share (Techwing about KRW 200 billion); SoC handler market about KRW 900 billion, 5% share (about KRW 50 billion); Cube Prober 100% share
